title: Signal and Terminal
author: Elodie Winterbourne
blurb: Xanthe Villalobos, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
